lines.personal_line: Your range of international foods reaches independent retailers, supermarkets and caterers across Ireland and Northern Ireland. Sugar free confectionery would be a new category for you, and we would welcome a partnership that grows it through that network.

lines.subject_line: Sugar free range for Conaty Catering
lines.personal_line: You supply restaurants, cafes, hotels and caterers six days a week with no minimum order. Our sugar free syrups and spreads could give your cafe customers something new, and we would like to grow that together.

lines.subject_line: Barry Group and Diablo Sugar Free
lines.personal_line: Your wholesale network supplies Costcutter, Carry Out and Quik Pick stores across Ireland. A sugar free snack range moving through that supply chain could reach a wide base of independent shoppers, and we would welcome a partnership.

lines.subject_line: Sugar free snacks for Chemist Warehouse
lines.personal_line: Your large format stores across Dublin, Cork, Limerick and other counties, with five more planned for 2026, show real momentum. A sugar free snack range could sit well alongside your health foods as you grow.

lines.subject_line: Inish Pharmacy and Diablo Sugar Free
lines.personal_line: You already offer sugar free sweets from Sula to customers across Ireland. Our chocolate, biscuits and spreads could extend that into a fuller sugar free range, and we would welcome a partnership as you grow online.

lines.subject_line: Lynas Foodservice and Diablo Sugar Free
lines.personal_line: You supply over 5,000 foodservice customers across Northern Ireland, Ireland and Scotland. Adding a sugar free range to that offer could give your customers a new choice, and we would welcome a partnership that grows with you.
